criteria.criterion: When an iteration ends blocked, the previous iteration worked the same task and also ended blocked, and nothing outside the driver's own bookkeeping under .loop/state/ changed in the repo between the start of those two sessions — in particular no path in the task's files — the run halts after that second iteration without starting a third session.
criteria.evidence: .loop/run.sh:1128-1148 diffs the stored blocked_head against pre-commit HEAD, filters .loop/state/, and sets repeat_blocked_halt=1 which breaks the loop at .loop/run.sh:1187-1191; traced by hand through 42-repeat-blocked-halts.sh's 'rb 0' case and confirmed by running it (halts after iteration 2, exit 8)

criteria.criterion: The halt message and the run-end report surface the first of the two blocked diagnoses (the earlier iteration's summary), not only the second, and name the task.
criteria.evidence: .loop/run.sh:1136 reads prev_summary before the state is overwritten, and repeat_blocked_msg (used both in the mid-loop warn at line 1188 and the run-end case arm at line 1241) embeds "$task" and "${prev_summary}"; verified in the scenario's 'diagnosis 1' / not-'diagnosis 2' assertions, which pass

criteria.criterion: When the earlier blocked session did change something, the retry is allowed and the rule is re-evaluated on the following pair; a run in which the first blocked session edited a file and the next two did not halts after the third iteration, surfacing the second iteration's diagnosis.
criteria.evidence: 42-repeat-blocked-halts.sh 'rb 1' case: 3 iterations, halts on the third, surfaces 'diagnosis 2' — matches the git-history trace (diff between iter1-commit and iter2-commit is non-empty because iter1 touched thing.txt, so iter2 is allowed; diff between iter2-commit and iter3-commit is empty, so iter3 halts)

criteria.criterion: The halt decides nothing about the task: status stays as the normal blocked transition left it (pending, attempts charged as today); only the run stops, non-zero exit, no new iterations.jsonl outcome value.
criteria.evidence: the case-block status transition (.loop/run.sh ~1113) runs before the new item-7 block and is untouched by it; assert_status/assert_attempts in both scenarios confirm pending/attempts as expected; iterations.jsonl record at ~1163 still uses the unmodified $outcome ("blocked"), and 15-telemetry-contract's 'every outcome is one of the four contract values' still passes
